values: 将自己和一名敌人转移到其他空间。
Reinier teleports to another dimension with an enemy.
选择一名敌人，对其造成230% + 20% ATK伤害，并使自身和该敌人转移至另一维度的空间中，持续10秒。除召唤物外，若敌方存活人数多于己方，则自身会留在场上。当该目标处于稳定、霸体或敌方存活的非召唤物角色仅剩该目标时，则不会将其转移，而是造成450% ATK伤害。本技能优先选择最健康的非召唤物敌人作为目标。

If non-summoned allies outnumber non-summoned enemies, Reinier selects an enemy, dealing 230% + 20% ATK damage, and teleporting to another dimension with the target for 10s.
Otherwise, only the target will be teleported to another dimension while Reinier remains on the battlefield.
If the target is under steadfast or unaffected, or if the target is the only non-summoned enemy alive, Reinier will deal 450% ATK damage instead of entering another dimension. This skill prioritizes the healthiest non-summoned enemy.
释放“共形映射”时，若敌方除召唤物外存活的人数比我方多至少2名，则“共形映射”会额外对一名敌人生效，该敌人转移至另一维度的空间的持续时间降低至7秒。
The Mutual Reflection works on an extra enemy if non-summoned enemies outnumber allies by at least 2. Reduces the duration of transferring this enemy to another dimension to 7s.
伤害提升至250% + 20% ATK，当该目标处于稳定、霸体或敌方存活的非召唤物角色仅剩该目标时，伤害提升至460% ATK。
Increases the damage to 250% + 20% ATK. The damage is increased to 460% ATK if the target is steadfast, unaffected, or the only non-summoned unit alive.
伤害提升至260% + 20% ATK，当该目标处于稳定、霸体或敌方存活的非召唤物角色仅剩该目标时，伤害提升至480% ATK。
Increases the damage to 260% + 20% ATK. The damage is increased to 480% ATK if the target is steadfast, unaffected, or the only non-summoned unit alive.
伤害提升至270% + 20% ATK，当该目标处于稳定、霸体或敌方存活的非召唤物角色仅剩该目标时，伤害提升至500% ATK。
Increases the damage to 270% + 20% ATK. The damage is increased to 500% ATK if the target is steadfast, unaffected, or the only non-summoned unit alive.
战斗开始时，雷内亚使一名友方英雄和与之处于对称位置的敌方英雄交换位置。
Reinier switches an allied hero's position with an enemy hero if they're in a symmetrical position when the battle starts.
战斗开始时，若自身1格范围内存在一名友军与敌军的位置处于对称关系，雷内亚将会释放本技能使双方互换位置，优先以自身身后的友军作为目标。该敌军每次受到伤害时，该友军恢复等同于伤害量45%的生命值，持续到战斗结束，通过这个方式每连续8秒内恢复生命值的总量不超过1000% + 100% ATK。

When a battle starts, Reinier switches an adjacent ally's position with an enemy if they're in symmetrical positions. Whenever the enemy takes damage, the ally restores HP equal to 45% of the enemy's taken damage till a battle ends. The total HP recovery amount by this means is no more than 1000% + 100% ATK in a consecutive 8s.
友方英雄恢复等同于伤害量46%的生命值。
Restores allied hero's HP equal to 46% of damage dealt.
友方英雄恢复等同于伤害量48%的生命值。
Restores allied hero's HP equal to 48% of damage dealt.
友方英雄恢复等同于伤害量50%的生命值。
Restores allied hero's HP equal to 50% of damage dealt.
对敌人造成多段伤害并击飞。
Reinier deals multiple damage to the enemy and knocks them into the air.
透过传送门对最健康的敌人进行猛烈的击打，造成打断效果并对其造成8次45% + 3% ATK伤害，随后施展最后一拳造成120% ATK伤害并将其击飞。若敌人生命值比例高于61.8%，每次攻击附带敌人当前生命值1%伤害，最多不超过自身攻击力的20%。

Reinier launches a mighty strike against the healthiest enemy through the portal, interrupting them and dealing 45% + 3% ATK damage 8 times. Afterward, Reinier punches and knocks them into the air, dealing 120% ATK damage. If the enemy's HP ratio is above 61.8%, then each hit attaches extra damage equal to 1% of their current HP, up to 20% of ATK.
每个敌人生命值比例首次低于61.8%时，雷内亚感受到一阵满足，使自身恢复200% ATK生命值和80点能量。
Reinier senses satisfaction when each enemy's HP ratio drops below 61.8% for the first time, recovering 200% ATK HP and 80 Energy.
每次攻击附带伤害提升至敌人当前生命值的1.2%。
The damage of each strike is increased to 1.2% of the enemy's current HP.
每个敌人生命值比例首次低于61.8%时，雷内亚还会与友军分享满足感，使所有友军恢复120% ATK生命值和50点能量。
Reinier shares satisfaction with allies when each enemy's HP ratio drops below 61.8% for the first time, granting all allies 120% ATK HP and 50 Energy.
使“动态平衡”交换位置的友军攻击力提升，交换位置的敌军攻击力降低。
Reinier can use Dynamic Balance to either boost an ally's ATK or lower an enemy's ATK.
“动态平衡”互换的友军攻击力提升7%，互换的敌军攻击力降低7%。
Reinier's Dynamic Balance increases the target's ATK by 7% when cast on an ally or reduces the target ATK by 7% when cast on an enemy.
“动态平衡”互换的友军攻击力提升10%，互换的敌军攻击力降低10%。
Reinier's Dynamic Balance increases the target's ATK by 10% when cast on an ally or reduces the target ATK by 10% when cast on an enemy.
“动态平衡”互换的友军攻击力提升12%，互换的敌军攻击力降低12%。
Reinier's Dynamic Balance increases the target's ATK by 12% when cast on an ally or reduces the target ATK by 12% when cast on an enemy.
雷内亚重创“动态平衡”交换位置的敌军，使其受到伤害提升，并降低交换位置的友军受到的伤害。
Reinier wounds the enemy with Dynamic Balance, causing the enemy to take more damage while reducing the damage taken by the ally.
释放“动态平衡”时，还会对该敌人造成200% ATK伤害并击倒，使其受到伤害提高25%，持续到战斗结束。
Reinier deals 200% ATK damage to the enemy and knocks them down when casting Dynamic Balance, increasing their damage taken by 25% till the battle ends.
对该敌人造成伤害提升至250% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to the enemy to 250% ATK.
释放“动态平衡”还会使该友军受到伤害降低25%，持续到战斗结束。
Reduces the position-switched ally's damage taken by 25% till the battle ends.
对该敌人造成伤害提升至300% ATK。
Increases damage dealt to the enemy to 300% ATK.
战斗开始时，与敌方英雄处于对称关系的我方英雄攻击力提升。
Reinier increases the allied hero's ATK if they're in a symmetrical position with an enemy hero when a battle starts.
战斗开始时，我方英雄的位置若与敌方英雄处于对称关系，则攻击力提升4%，持续到战斗结束。
Reinier increases the allied hero's ATK by 4% till the battle ends if they're in a symmetrical position with an enemy hero.
